responsibilities.description: Select this if you will use a coding agent: an AI tool that can read or edit files and run commands after your approval in a lab project folder. Ordinary chatbot use outside lab work is not included.
Select this if you need the lab's shared remote Windows computer for licensed graphical engineering software such as computer-aided design (CAD) or simulation pre/post-processing.
Select this if you decide where shared datasets and results belong, who may access them, or how they are handed to the next person. A dataset is a collection of research data.
Select this for programs that should run on Euler, ETH Zurich's service made of many managed computers for research calculations. A CPU is the general-purpose processor used by most programs.

Select this for programs written and tested to use a GPU, an accelerator for compatible software, on Euler. The CPU lessons come first because CPU and GPU work use the same Euler connection and scheduling system.
Select this if you will change code or documentation shared on GitHub. Git records file versions; GitHub stores the shared project and its reviews.
Select this if you need the NAS, the lab's durable shared drive reached through the ETH network, for approved project data, saved program or model states, results, or deliverables.

Select this if you will run or edit Python code. Python is a programming language. A package adds reusable code; an environment keeps one project's Python and packages separate so the setup can be recreated.
Select this if you choose a person's onboarding lessons, approve access, own research data, or organize the transfer of work when someone joins or leaves.
